authors: Erfan Mohammadian, Hossein Hamidi, Mohammad Asadullah, Amin Azdarpour, Shervin Motamedi, Radzuan Junin
title: Measurement of CO2 Solubility in NaCl Brine Solutions at Different Temperatures and Pressures Using the Potentiometric Titration Method
experimental_method: CO2 equilibrated 3 h with brine in a 100 mL stirred autoclave; a sample is drawn into a floating-piston sampler holding NaOH, then titrated potentiometrically with 0.5 M HCl to get dissolved CO2 per mass of sample.
uncertainties_stated: U(T) = 0.05 C, U(P) = 0.02 MPa, U(m) = 0.0020 mol/kg, U(x) = 0.050 mol/kg in table footnotes (text says 0.001 mol/kg), U(Ke) = 0.03.
quality_remarks: Table footnote U(x)=0.050 mol/kg conflicts with text (0.001 mol/kg). Abstract and text mention 100 C data and Fig. 3-6 show them, but no table lists 100 C. Solubility called 'molal' but computed per mass of titrated sample (solution). Unusual points were removed as outliers by the authors (SPSS). CO2 solubility at 0.1 MPa is tiny and U(x) of 0.05 mol/kg would swamp it.
not_extracted_tables: Setchenov constant Ke columns are authors' calculations and are kept only as unmapped companion columns
extraction_notes: Text-layer parse of the two-column tables was scrambled by interleaving, so all three tables were written from the page images and then each row was searched for in the text layer (all found). Printed dashes are empty cells (x0 at 6.2 and 21.3 MPa, 60 C; Ke where no x0).
needs_pass2_reason: text layer interleaved two tables so the tables were hand-transcribed from images
